model_status: Frozen core formula with seven original CHARLS 2011-frozen outcome-specific mapping heads
default_governance: Original CHARLS 2011-frozen heads are used by default. CHARLS 2015 recalibration is secondary sensitivity only.

core_formula.note: No z-score, mean/SD, or median/IQR standardization is applied.

threshold_policy: No diagnostic/risk/treatment cutoff is optimized or recommended.

interpretation.handgrip_strength: Do not describe as a clinically accurate substitute for measured handgrip strength.
interpretation.smi: Do not equate with DXA/BIA-measured muscle mass.
interpretation.low_muscle_strength: Moderate temporal discrimination and calibration drift; not a stand-alone diagnostic probability.
interpretation.low_estimated_muscle_mass: Good temporal discrimination/calibration; external evidence is construct-level rather than identical-definition validation.
interpretation.possible_sarcopenia: Weak temporal discrimination persisted after recalibration; exploratory only.
interpretation.sarcopenia: Primary probability output; original frozen target.
interpretation.severe_sarcopenia: Strong temporal discrimination but baseline-risk calibration drift; not a clinically validated absolute severity risk.

privacy: All calculations are performed locally in the browser.
